title: feat: add agent usage quests
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds one-time quests: use any agent (0.25 Pollen), and create an agent used at least once (2 Pollen). The creator’s own successful test counts.
- Reuses existing request events and the normal reward ledger/claim flow. No new event fields, Gen changes, or D1 migrations. Prompt, code, and externally hosted agents qualify; failed/internal calls and proxies do not.
- Keeps a small Tinybird summary: the direct 3-month query scanned 83.6M rows and took 5.7s. Creator matching uses the recorded GitHub username; username changes before claiming can lose historical eligibility.
- Verified: 37 quest tests including exact credits and duplicate claims, typecheck, Biome, 14 SQL cases against staging, and Tinybird dry-run validation.
- Rollout prerequisite: deploy the additive Tinybird summary and endpoint to staging, verify, then production before activating Enter. Nothing deployed. Backfill covers 3 months of classified agent events; flags persist afterward.

gist.headline: Agents, meet the quest garden
gist.blurb: Two new quest seeds are ready for the agent garden: try any agent for 0.25 Pollen, or create one that gets used for 2 Pollen. Your own successful test run counts too, because shipping an agent should not require finding a ceremonial second person.
gist.summary: Added one-time Enter quests rewarding 0.25 Pollen for using any qualifying agent and 2 Pollen for creating an agent that is successfully used at least once, using existing classified request events and the normal reward claim ledger.
gist.impact: Prompt, code, and externally hosted agents can earn these rewards after rollout, with a three-month backfill of classified agent events and duplicate claims prevented by the existing quest flow.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli tending a cozy agent garden where three kinds of code-plants—prompt scroll, code terminal, and small hosted-server pot—have sprouted into reward flowers labeled 0.25 and 2 Pollen. Polli should be actively testing one plant with a tiny clipboard, while the eager CRT Monitor Robot confirms a successful run; use small quest badges and a normal ledger book to show that usage becomes a claimable reward.
